artifact_version: VN Companion RC29.64 · Travel Engine 25.7.0 Browser Mutation Gate Isolation Candidate
capabilities_changed: Booking edits now use an Engine-level per-booking in-flight mutation lock; DOM disabled state is no longer the concurrency authority.
Browser release authority now covers Chromium desktop/mobile plus WebKit iPhone-class 390×844 and 430×932 viewports.
Cross-reference integrity CI rejects Guide day-label/URL mismatches, missing Timeline anchors, missing booking places and broken booking Timeline references.
Canonical Place records can carry source provenance metadata (type, URL, verifiedAt); Fusion, Pizza 4P’s and Qspa seed the official-source pilot.
Existing generic accommodation cashback/payment behavior and Qspa single D1-D3 authority are preserved.
obsolete_or_rejected: historical shared Trip/Guide overlay geometry ownership
release_status: RC29.64 CANDIDATE — browser mutation gate isolation + 25.7 local-first booking save lifecycle
changes: Replaced button-only double-submit protection with BOOKING_SAVE_IN_FLIGHT, acquired synchronously per booking ID and released in finally after the commit settles.
Unexpected commit exceptions now resolve through the existing save-failure path while still releasing the booking mutation lock.
Added Chromium + WebKit browser release matrix; GitHub workflow provisions both browser engines.
Added cross-reference integrity validator to the mandatory DATA INTEGRITY suite.

The new validator immediately found and corrected legacy Guide routing drift: Fusion Day 1 hotel anchor, D2 fashion links, D1 Nguyễn Trãi links, LÜNE Day 2, Running Bean Day 4, and retired Mộc Healing timeline link.
Added source provenance contract and official verifiedAt metadata for Fusion Original Saigon Centre, Pizza 4P’s Hai Bà Trưng and Qspa Trương Định.
No itinerary schedule, booking status, payment amount or D4/D5 plan was intentionally changed.

Booking Save is now local-first: the local Booking Authority commits before remote sync, so slow/unavailable sync cannot hold the editor open; remote failure returns a successful degraded/sync-pending outcome while the booking-level in-flight lock still prevents duplicate mutations.

Browser double-submit smoke now disables remote BOOKING_SYNC only for the mutation-count assertion, preventing legitimate post-save reconciliation from being miscounted as a second user commit on mobile.
